overview: A semi-integrated system that packages the core optical path while retaining user access to the sample and selected beam-conditioning components. It targets reproducible routine measurements with moderate customization.
overviewZh: 将核心光路集成封装，同时保留样品端和部分光束整形部件的操作空间，适合具有一定定制需求的常规重复测量。
principle: The semi-integrated version uses the same steady-heating principle as laboratory SSTR. Pump-induced heat spreads through the film stack and substrate; the probe measures the resulting surface-reflectance change. Fitting the power-normalized response requires known beam geometry and calibration. Integration changes implementation, not the underlying measurement physics.
principleZh: 半集成版本沿用稳态泵浦加热原理，热量经膜层与衬底扩散，探测光读取由表面温升引起的反射率变化。拟合功率归一化响应时，需要光斑几何与响应标定。集成程度改变实现形式，不改变基本测量原理。
